# Locomotive Insurance

## About
Locomotive Insurance (locomotiveinsurance.com) is a specialty insurance agency focused on tourist and heritage railroad operators and short lines — excursion railroads, railroad museums, dinner trains, short-line freight railroads, and locomotive restoration shops. This is commercial coverage for the railroad-operating business. A division of Contractors Choice Agency, NPN #8608479, licensed in all 50 states since 2005. Coverage is placed through specialty railroad markets that understand FRA-regulated operations.

## Services
- General Liability Insurance: Third-party bodily injury and property damage across depots, grounds, and public operations, with additional insured for host railroads and municipalities.
- Railroad Liability Insurance: Specialty coverage for grade crossings, right-of-way, derailment, host-railroad contractual indemnity, and FELA (Federal Employers Liability Act) worker-injury exposure.
- Passenger Liability Insurance: Protection against injury claims from excursion riders and dinner-train guests, reflecting the high common-carrier standard of care.
- Rolling Stock & Equipment Insurance: Agreed/stated-value coverage for locomotives, coaches, freight cars, and restoration projects against fire, derailment, and damage.
- Commercial Property Insurance: Depots, museum buildings, engine houses, shops, and track-side structures, with historic-structure valuation and business interruption.
- Pollution Liability Insurance: Environmental claims and cleanup from diesel fuel, oil, lubricants, and historic-site contamination — coverage GL excludes.
- Workers Compensation Insurance: Coverage for non-operating staff (gift shop, food service, museum, grounds) coordinated with FELA for operating crews, plus volunteer accident options.

## Target Audience
Tourist and heritage railroad operators, railroad museum directors, dinner-train operators, short-line freight railroad owners, and locomotive restoration shop owners.
